custom_fields.description: Discount applied when a monthly-priced plan is billed on a yearly term: yearly rate = monthly x 12 x (1 - discount).
custom_fields.label: Annual Discount Percentage

custom_fields.description: On mid-term cancellation of an anchored or consolidated subscription, issue a Credit Note for the unused portion of the current period.
custom_fields.label: Credit Note On Cancellation

custom_fields.description: For anchored or consolidated subscriptions added mid-term: bill the prorated stub as soon as the subscription is created (Immediate, stock behaviour) or leave it to the next scheduled run (Next Daily Run). Next Daily Run rejects start dates more than one billing cycle in the past.
custom_fields.label: Mid-term Billing Mode

custom_fields.description: A subscription invoice whose due date is more than this many days in the past is not auto-charged; its Payment Request is left as a draft for review.
custom_fields.label: Auto-charge Max Lateness (days)
